name: Default
shortDescription: Open business management platform (ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, PM) with time tracking, invoicing and projects, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: The first start runs the database migrations and seeds it, which can take several minutes. Then sign in as DEMO_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@ever.co) with the generated DEMO_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. The seeded accounts are created only on the first start, so change the email there before the first deploy.
Invitations and password resets need email: set up SMTP in Settings > Custom SMTP after signing in.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
